name: Food
description: Food word search puzzles for people who like a calm kitchen-minded break. Free online grids gather herbs, bakers staples, market produce and quiet cooking words — no restaurant brands, just everyday vocabulary. Start easy, step up to medium with diagonals, or try a hard puzzle with reverse words. Large print is available when you want bigger letters. No account, no download, no timer: just a gentle word list and a few unhurried minutes.
